name: SOCI 2198
title: Topics in the Sociology of Culture
description: A variable topics course focusing on issues in the sociology of culture. Specific topics may include: production of culture and the culture industry, popular culture, the sociology of the arts, cultural representation of deviance and social problems, women and culture, film and the developing world, material culture, and cultural constructions of social inequality. May be repeated for a total of 9 credits.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
